
  ▲ vercel project list [options]

  Show all projects in the selected scope                                       

  Options:

   --filter <NAME>    Filter projects by name (substring match)                  
   --json             Output as JSON                                             
   --limit <NUMBER>   Number of results to return per page (default: 20, max:    
                      100)                                                       
   --next <CURSOR>    Show the next page using the cursor from the previous      
                      output                                                     
   --paused           Show only projects whose production traffic is paused      
   --update-required  A list of projects affected by an upcoming deprecation     


  Global Options:

       --cwd <DIR>            Sets the current working directory for a single   
                              run of a command                                  
  -d,  --debug                Debug mode (default: off)                         
  -Q,  --global-config <DIR>  Path to the global `.vercel` directory            
  -h,  --help                 Output usage information                          
  -A,  --local-config <FILE>  Path to the local `vercel.json` file              
       --no-color             No color mode (default: off)                      
       --non-interactive      Run without interactive prompts (default: on when 
                              an agent is detected)                             
  -S,  --scope                Set a custom scope                                
  -t,  --token <TOKEN>        Login token                                       
  -v,  --version              Output the version number                         


  Examples:

  - Paginate projects, where `1584722256178` is the time in milliseconds since the UNIX epoch

    $ vercel project list --next <CURSOR>

  - List projects using a deprecated Node.js version in JSON format

    $ vercel project list --update-required --json

  - Filter projects by name

    $ vercel project list --filter my-app

  - List paused projects

    $ vercel project list --paused
